qualifier_in_source: Effect concentrated in accounts older than 6 months.

judgments.note: States impact concentrated in accounts more than six months old.
Says particularly those older than six months.
'especially 6+ months old' conveys the scope restriction.
Limits effect to accounts 6+ months old.
'after 6 months' conveys age limit, though account referent dropped.
'best after six months' retains the age-based restriction, less explicitly.
